title: Boy is “she” pretty; “she” works like any coffee press I tried; use coarse grind; holds 4 cups not 8
text:
Boy is “she” pretty; “she” works like any coffee press I tried; use coarse grind; holds 4 cups not 8. I tried several coffee presses previously and have another one that I purchased at a local store for half the price. This press works no differently. The only difference is this one is prettier due to the red metal casing.

I use this for tea but it is designed for either coffee or tea. If using coffee, make sure to use a coarse grind as a fine grind will clog the mesh filter. When using tea, also make sure the leaves are not so small that one would consider them tea dust.

After washing this out, I removed the cover, added my tea (enough for four 8 ounce cups), poured boling water into the carafe, inserted the plunger and pushed down slowly. I waited the requisite four minutes for it to steep and then enjoyed my brew. I had a few miniscule leaves escape but not much and they remained on the bottom. I got two full mugs of tea from this. This fits four cups of water up to the base of the top red rim.

There are two things I do not like about this product. First, when drying the glass with a towel, the carafe moves around easily in its frame. I had to keep turning it so the spout pointed opposite the handle. My other press does not move around so easily in the frame. Second, at the current price of $39.99, this costs twice as much as a comparable no-name press.

In summary, "she" is beautiful but "she" is also expensive and "her" frame is loosely seated around the carafe. Also, this does not hold eight cups as the Amazon site says; it holds four cups (32 ounces) of water. Otherwise, this brews a nice cup of tea (or coffee) as long as one does not use a fine grind or fine leaf.

product_metadata.title: Primula Melrose French Tea Maker, Stainless Steel Coffee Press, Premium Filtration with No Grounds, Heat Resistant Borosilicate Glass, 8 Cup, Red
features: Durable construction- The premium Melrose French press Coffee maker is constructed of premium stainless steel and high quality borosilicate glass. This French press is built for performance for your French press Coffee making needs.
Premium filtration system- The fine stainless steel French press Coffee plunger filter is perfect for making flavorful Coffee without sediment.

Flavorful Coffee or tea- use the Melrose French press to make flavorful Coffee or tea. Coffee lovers can add favorite flavors such as vanilla, cinnamon or coconut before cold brewing while tea lovers can add mint or citrus zest.
Easy to clean- the Melrose French press Coffee maker is as easy to clean as it is to use.

Easy to use- you can make flavorful French press Coffee in just 3 simple steps: 1) Remove the French press plunger and add desired amount of Coffee grounds. 2) pour hot water and allow Coffee to brew to desired strength. 3) serve and enjoy.
Makes a great gift: the Melrose Coffee press is great for gift giving for Coffee lovers, foodies, tea lovers and more.
description: Here’s another winning creation by our Primula experts in Coffee press Design—The Melrose 8-Cup Coffee press is as aesthetically pleasing as it easy to use. Crafted of sturdy borosilicate glass with a sleek metallic finish, The Melrose adds a sophisticated flair to the kitchen or breakfast nook. With our signature filter/plunger technology, Coffee service is nice and easy. First, spoon your favorite freshly ground Coffee bean blend into the temperature-safe glass beaker, pour in piping hot water, and let steep (longer for bolder flavor). attach the filter plunger, and press down. The cleverly designed lid and spout assure clean, even pouring. Enjoy!
